items.headline: NYT: US/Israel drew up specific plans for renewed attacks on Iran after the Nov-3 midterms; US ordered diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia amid Houthi strikes — Brent $113.20 (+4%), WTI $99.45 (+2.4%)
10Y sank below 5% (-18bp from Wed close) as investors fled to bonds; Nasdaq/S&P plunged on AI-spending concerns (Lam Research -10%, Meta down) — risk-off, no USD haven bid (DXY 101.62, near 3-wk low)
USD/JPY -0.8% to ~156.85 — yen's best day in a month on the Gulf-escalation haven bid + dollar-long paring
Gold ~$4,045 (-2.5%, 5th straight down day) despite falling yields — selling with stocks, not on rates; spot fell to $4,057.55 at 7:45am ET, below early-October lows
US jobless claims 194K (vs 200K fcst; -6K; near 57-year lows); continuing claims 1.728M (+25K). Fed funds futures cut Oct-28 hike odds to ~11% (from ~13%)
Canada IPPI +2.0% m/m beat (vs 0.7% fcst; +14.5% y/y, 24th straight annual gain); RMPI +4.8% beat (vs 0.1%; +27.0% y/y) — upstream heat 6 days before the Oct-28 BoC
CBI Oct industrial order expectations -32 miss (vs -20 fcst, from -9); UK factory gloom deepens, output outlook steadies — GBP held near 1-month high on the CPI-driven BoE path
China FDI -4.3% y/y Jan-Sep (548.8B yuan, $82.2B) — decline narrowed from -5.3%; high-tech +33.8%
SNB September-discussions summary (released Oct 22): franc's carry-trade appeal acknowledged (widening rate differentials, low volatility); FX intervention readiness eased — tolerates franc weakness
NZ Q3 CPI 0.7% q/q, 3.7% y/y — soft miss vs 0.8%/3.8% fcst (below RBNZ 3.9% proj, still above 1–3% target); NZD dipped to $0.5692
RBNZ Oct-28 hike ~98% (Reuters, Oct 22 — up from ~80%); 100% chance of 50bp of hikes before end-February
US ordered departure of embassy staff and families from Saudi Arabia amid Houthi threat (Oct 21); NYT: US/Israel drew up post-midterm Iran strike plans
CME FedWatch (Oct 21): Oct 27-28 hike only ~16%; December hike ~90% — 'nearly all economists polled by Reuters' see the Fed skipping Oct for a December move
Gold ~$4,115 — 5th straight down day, trading December-hike odds (~90%) not oil headlines; $4,150 re-test faded
RBA Nov-3 hike ~42% (LSEG, Oct 21; OIS 41-55%): Goldman Sachs flipped to a November 25bp call (to 4.85%); Q3 CPI Oct 28 the pivot
US 20-yr auction (Oct 21): $13B at 5.469% — record high since the May-2020 reintroduction; tailed WI by 0.9bp (4th tail); B/C 2.73; indirects 58.2% (soft foreign demand)
BoJ Dec hike ~80% (Japan Times/Bloomberg, Oct 21, via ex-BoJ exec Maeda); Oct 29-30 hold ~88-90%; national core CPI tonight 18:30 CT (2.1% fcst)
ECB Dec hike ~76% (ECB Watch); IMF (Oct 16) expects at least one more 25bp ECB hike in 2026 to contain core inflation
BoE Nov-5 hike ~98.8% (LSEG, Oct 21); Pantheon sees Nov + Feb hikes, 'very close' to a third in May; markets price ~4 hikes by mid-2027
UK Sep CPI verified: 3.5% y/y beat (vs 3.4% fcst; highest since Oct 2025 on energy; core 2.8%; services 3.7% sticky) — locks BoE Nov-5 hike; GBP near 1-m high, 17-mth high vs EUR
BoC Oct-28 hike ~93% (CORRA OIS, BlueGamma Oct 21; +23bp implied); Canada IPPI/NHPI/RMPI today 7:30 CT
France: OAT 10Y toward 24-year highs on fiscal stress; OAT-Bund ~153bp; revenue-section vote postponed (first reading Oct 27; 49.3 floated); Moody's reviews Friday (Aa3 neg)
